# MERIDIAN CITY — project context

**App:** `game/gta.html` — a procedural third-person sandbox city. Geometry is generated by code. Opens straight from `file://`, no build, no server.

## Working rules for this project

- Temp files, screenshots and throwaway scripts go to the session scratchpad, **never** into the working folder. Exception: `harness/check-city.js` — the dev harness (see [methodology/contracts/harness.md](<methodology/contracts/harness.md>)).
- Git repo: `origin` -> GTA (GitHub). Commit each verified change; roll back with `git log` / `git restore`.
- Talk to the user briefly and to the point.
- **Language.** Write **in English** — code comments, contracts, `methodology/` docs, `AGENTS.md`, `handsoff.md`, commit messages, filenames. 
Existing Russian  is **not translated opportunistically**: leave it as-is until you have another reason to edit that exact line, then translate it in the same edit. Rewriting  whole files just to switch language is forbidden — it destroys blame and hides real changes. Historical commits stay as they are; the rule applies going forward.
  Language exceptions:
  - `journal/*.md` — written for the user, in **Russian**.
  - `gta.html` GUI strings — user-facing, keep as authored.

## Repository layout

- `game/` — playable substrate (`game/gta.html`). Playable without a build, Three.js from CDN.
- `assets/` — split into small classic `<script>`s (`file://` blocks sibling ES-module imports): `geom.js` (shared geometry kit), `asset-registry.js` (`MeridianAssets` catalogue), `day-cycle.js` (`MeridianDayCycle`), `traffic-ai.js` (`MeridianTrafficAI`), `vehicles.js` (fleet assembly), and one file per model under `assets/models/` (hero, pedestrian, car, bus, semi, building, tree, streetlight, park, road, distant-city). Every model registers itself in `MeridianAssets`; the list under `assets/models/manifest.js` is generated by `./sync_models.sh`. Palettes are load-time mutable on each kit. Preview pages: `assets/viewer.html` (interactive) and `assets/diagnostic.html` (checks each `makePreview` in a browser tab).
- Contracts: [methodology/contracts/](<methodology/contracts/>), architecture: [methodology/docs/](<methodology/docs/>).
  - [methodology/contracts/](<methodology/contracts/>) — invariants (camera, traffic-lanes, right-of-way, render-api, character-anatomy, world-constants, boot-sequence, harness, asset-contract)
  - [methodology/docs/](<methodology/docs/>) — architecture
  - [methodology/handsoff.md](<methodology/handsoff.md>) — state at the end of the last session; **the only state file an agent reads**
- `harness/` — checks and glue (`check-city.js`, `package.json`).
- `tools/` — repo scripts: `sync-ides.sh` (regenerate adapters), `lint-refs.sh` (repo linter: doc wiring, r128 API guard, comment rules).
- `ides/` — environment adapters; generated by `tools/sync-ides.sh`.
- `journal/` — per-session log, **written for humans**.

Always write methodology/ as part of a path. Do not use it as a standalone word in prose: either a full link (methodology/contracts/camera.md) or no slash at all ("the methodology folder").

## Running it

Open `game/gta.html` in a browser (drag it into the window, or `file:///…/game/gta.html`). Internet is needed for the CDN Three.js. Controls: click — capture mouse; WASD/arrows — walk; Shift — run; Esc — release the mouse.

Three.js is pinned to `0.160.x` via `importmap`; see [methodology/contracts/render-api.md](<methodology/contracts/render-api.md>) for the API contract and [methodology/contracts/asset-contract.md](<methodology/contracts/asset-contract.md>) for the asset contract. `renderer.useLegacyLights = true` is a migration stopgap (r155 changed the default) — see [methodology/handsoff.md](<methodology/handsoff.md>) → *Open questions*.

## Where to look when fixing something — methodology/

Three rules that keep context small:

- **State.** Read [methodology/handsoff.md](<methodology/handsoff.md>) and nothing else. It is a short cache of where
  the project stands. `journal/` is for humans: an agent must not open it during normal work. The journal grows one
  file per session while handoff stays flat, so reading history costs more every time and tells you no more — state
  is only ever authoritative in handoff. If a session changes the state, it updates handoff there instead of leaving
  it for whoever comes next to reconstruct.
- **Domain.** Find the task in the table below and open **only** that row. Do not read `methodology/` end to end
  (~70 KB): the summary column is enough to decide whether a file matters, and the file itself is only needed when
  touching that domain.
- **Contract depth.** Every contract file is two parts: `## Rules — read always` (one line per invariant) and
  `## Rationale & examples`, which holds the evidence, history and numbers. Review, triage and harness runs stop after
  *Rules*; open a rule's evidence only when editing that behaviour.

Three layers of "unfinished" — each has exactly one home, do not mix them up:

| Layer | Meaning | Home |
|---|---|---|
| Open question | unresolved: needs a decision or a measurement before anything changes | named once in [methodology/handsoff.md](<methodology/handsoff.md>) → *Open questions*, written up under the same heading in the owning contract |
| Limitation | decided not to fix; accepted as is, with its cost | [methodology/docs/limitations.md](<methodology/docs/limitations.md>) |
| `TODO(sNN)` | known work that already has an owner session | a comment in `game/gta.html` |

An open question is not a "known limitation": the first waits for a decision, the second has already been taken. The
routing table's *Contents* column describes what a file holds permanently — never name an individual open question there.

| Task / keywords | Open | Contents (anchors citable from code comments) |
|---|---|---|
| camera, mouse look, view, pitch, camera under the asphalt, player collision | [methodology/contracts/camera.md](<methodology/contracts/camera.md>) | C-CAM-1…5 — `+e.movementY`, `ty = Math.max(0.35, …)`, ±1.35, exact AABB |
| loading, loader, boot order, generation errors (TDZ), Esc/re-lock, slider steals the cursor | [methodology/contracts/boot-sequence.md](<methodology/contracts/boot-sequence.md>) | C-BOOT-1…5 — `boot()` step order, loader hides itself at 100 % |
| traffic, cars, spawn, lanes, traffic multiplier | [methodology/contracts/traffic-lanes.md](<methodology/contracts/traffic-lanes.md>) | C-LANE-1…6 — `ROAD/4`, interior-line-only (cars **and** pedestrians), wrap, time scale |
| crossings, right of way, pedestrian stuck, give-way priority | [methodology/contracts/right-of-way.md](<methodology/contracts/right-of-way.md>) | C-ROW-1…6 — positional priority, `bodyGap()` counts bodies ahead only, one shared `xs.list`, `clearance(P)` |
| assets, models, canvas textures, palette/color, Three.js API, UV merge, moon billboard | [methodology/contracts/render-api.md](<methodology/contracts/render-api.md>) | C-API-1…7 — `outputColorSpace`/`SRGBColorSpace`, no r128 leftovers, indices by `.length` |
| character rig, head/arms, anatomy, eyes/blink | [methodology/contracts/character-anatomy.md](<methodology/contracts/character-anatomy.md>) | C-ANA-1…4 — head above torso, limb pivots, geometry face (no texture) |
| asset contract, rig, pose, layers, behaviors, sockets, contacts, capabilities, four-legged, vehicles, props | [methodology/contracts/asset-contract.md](<methodology/contracts/asset-contract.md>) | C-ASSET-1…13 — metre units, flat pose, mirror pairs, phase continuity, layer toggle, requires.three |
| ground collision, world bounds, road-line indexing, `±290` | [methodology/contracts/world-constants.md](<methodology/contracts/world-constants.md>) | C-WLD-1…4 — road-line indexing (the trap that cost two bug fixes); the `±290` asphalt deviation is accepted, not fixed |
| where is that section of `game/gta.html`?, load order, seeded RNG | [methodology/docs/architecture.md](<methodology/docs/architecture.md>) | line-numbered code map — re-derived live, authoritative |

Every invariant carries an anchor you can cite from a comment (`// see methodology/contracts/camera.md#C-CAM-1`).
`tools/lint-refs.sh` checks those citations and the router paths above, doc links inside methodology/, the pinned Three.js 0.160 API in `game/gta.html`, anchor format with documented prefixes, provenance labels on run metrics and numbered TODOs: exit 0 clean, 1 violated. Run it after editing contract headings, anchor comments or this table.

Rules for changing a contract — amend rather than relax, keep numeric couplings, the seeded RNG is contractual:
[methodology/contracts/README.md](<methodology/contracts/README.md>).

## Code comments

Rule: a comment explains **why**, not **what**.

Bad:

    // calculate gap
    const gap = bodyGap(car);

Good:

    // obstacles counted in front only — see methodology/contracts/right-of-way.md#C-ROW-2;
    // counting bodies behind a vehicle's own tail froze 20 of 52 cars
    const gap = bodyGap(car);

When a comment points at a contract, give the anchor exactly as its heading reads — `C-<DOMAIN>-N`, prefixes `CAM` / `BOOT` / `LANE` / `ROW` / `API` / `ANA` / `WLD` / `ASSET`:

    // see methodology/contracts/camera.md#C-CAM-2
    // (in snapshots — contracts/camera.md#C-CAM-2)

Do not write:

- Commented-out code (delete it; git remembers)
- TODOs without a session number (write: TODO(s05): ...)
- Comments that restate the code ("here we create the camera")
- Emoji in comments
